comparison.scope: map lifecycle repair, instant no-copy map transition, hidden resident launch restoration, whole-source reliability/performance audit, normal/debug logging split, and removal of obsolete runtime polling/scanning

preparation_environment.authoritative_runtime_gate: After deployment, Install.cmd must complete Windows PowerShell 5.1 Add-Type compilation and log OVERLAY_COMPILE_OK, INSTALLER_COMPILE_OK, RESIDENT_WATCHER_READY, and INSTALL_COMPLETE.

root_cause: The latest input kept the transparent layered Overlay at full game-client size even in radar mode, forcing continuous full-surface DWM composition.
The 24 ms radar producer path indirectly performed world-map UObject probing through a 96 ms detector and retained map-exit hysteresis/re-entry blocking.
High-detail Overlay performance logging ran during normal use instead of being debug-only.

world_map_lifecycle: Radar mode uses an actual small top-right window instead of a transparent full-client surface.
The Overlay is hidden before every radar/world geometry transition.

Map transitions have no timed reveal delay: SetWindowPos uses SWP_NOCOPYBITS, the newly sized hidden surface is repainted synchronously, paint completion is confirmed by a sequence counter, and a redundant post-show full-screen invalidate is skipped only when that hidden paint actually ran.
On the first missing active-map sample the producer clears map state, publishes radar motion when player coordinates are available, stops the world loop, and restarts the radar loop.
The 24 ms radar loop never probes world-map UObjects; entry detection remains in the 250 ms static loop, and active-map transforms are reused by the static publisher.
normal_mode_performance: Lua producer timing/counter collection is not instantiated unless debug logging is enabled.
Overlay Stopwatch timing, paint/timer counters, CPU/memory sampling, and periodic performance lines are disabled in normal mode.
The old no-op Boss tracker call was removed from the 250 ms state build.
mods.txt polling was reduced to 5000 ms while F7/F8 behavior remains unchanged.
Debug settings are parsed once at Overlay startup; normal Timer ticks and debug-log guards perform no recurring config-file stat/read work.
Runtime Boss rule PAK enumeration/decoding/regex parsing was removed; cooldowns use the verified fixed daily 09:00 local schedule.
Overlay static-state polling remains at 200 ms so removing the fixed reveal delay does not add another full producer-period of presentation latency.
Save-key lookup tries known RVAs before a delayed one-time worker-thread full-executable scan; transient key-initialization states neither trigger it early nor disable the fallback.
Launch request stamps contain digits only, have no trailing newline, and are validated before command construction.

logging_split.normal_mode_policy: startup, key/lifecycle state, warnings, and errors only; no periodic performance records
logging_split.debug_mode_policy: producer queue/update latency and 50/100/250 ms stalls, bridge sample/write rates, Overlay timer/paint pacing, normalized process CPU, working set, geometry, MAP_SURFACE_PREPARED transition timing, save, and Boss diagnostics
logging_split.fps_semantics: overlayPaintFps is the WinForms paint rate, not the game's Present FPS

reliability: All Lua game-thread queue and callback paths release pending gates after failure so later samples can recover.
Install.cmd starts and validates a resident hidden WScript watcher; game-time Lua writes only launch.request and creates no shell process.
The hidden PowerShell host binds to the exact game PID and exits with that process while the WScript watcher remains ready for later sessions.
A transient Process API failure no longer starts the game-exit shutdown countdown when a tracked PID exists.
SetWindowPos and module failures are isolated and rate-limited.
Expected pre-login save-key readiness is Debug-only; actionable save failures remain in the Use log.
Debug-mode configuration is startup-only; malformed or locked config falls back to normal mode without preventing Overlay startup.
Boss availability no longer depends on runtime filesystem scanning; the fixed rule-106 daily schedule is allocation-free and immutable.
